messages.content: Now I need the Denver hotel for Monday and Tuesday nights, November 9 and 10. Compare the full two-night totals, not just the nightly rates, and keep Tuesday’s 9:00 a.m. collection-facility start in mind.

I found two workable options for checkout Wednesday, November 11. Hyatt Place Denver/Cherry Creek is about 12 to 18 minutes by rideshare from the collection facility at that hour. Its king room is $189 per night prepaid or $214 per night with cancellation until 6:00 p.m. Sunday, November 8. Including taxes, the complete totals are $438.42 prepaid and $496.40 cancelable.

Hyatt Place Peña Station/Denver Airport has a king room for $166 per night, cancelable until 6:00 p.m. Sunday. Taxes bring the two-night total to $385.38. It is next to the airport rail line, but Tuesday’s drive to the facility is estimated at 35 to 50 minutes, with a longer range if traffic builds.
What departure times would you use Tuesday for each one? I cannot walk in at 9:00 exactly; I need about fifteen minutes to get settled before the inspection starts.

For an 8:45 a.m. arrival, I would request a rideshare by 8:15 a.m. from Cherry Creek. That allows roughly 20 minutes in the vehicle plus a small pickup cushion. From Peña Station, I would request it by 7:40 a.m.; the expected trip is around 40 minutes, but that timing leaves room for heavier traffic on the approach.
The closer one is worth considering. Does either Cherry Creek rate include breakfast and Wi-Fi, and are there any parking or resort charges buried outside those totals? I will not have a car.

Both Cherry Creek rates include breakfast and standard Wi-Fi. There is no resort or destination fee. The $438.42 and $496.40 totals each include the room charges and all mandatory lodging taxes. Parking is charged only if used, so it is not part of your stay. A refundable incidental hold may be placed on your card at check-in, but it is not a room charge.

I also need to know whether the desk can hold my suitcase and the documentation case early Tuesday morning. I may need to take the case to the facility later rather than carry both items through breakfast.

The Cherry Creek front desk confirmed that registered guests can leave both items with the luggage desk at about 7:00 a.m. Tuesday and retrieve either one before leaving. The desk operates around the clock, and there is no storage fee. They will tag the hard-sided case, but valuables and irreplaceable documents should remain with you. Peña Station also offers guest luggage storage, though it does not shorten the Tuesday drive.
Good. Compare the actual difference between the airport hotel and the flexible Cherry Creek rate, and between the two Cherry Creek rates.

The cancelable Cherry Creek stay is $111.02 more than Peña Station: $496.40 versus $385.38. Within Cherry Creek, the cancelable rate costs $57.98 more than the prepaid rate: $496.40 versus $438.42. The higher Cherry Creek rate preserves cancellation through 6:00 p.m. Sunday; the lower rate is charged when booked and cannot be changed or refunded.
The schedule is firm, but I do not want the hotel money locked up if the inspection is moved. Is there any partial refund or date change on the prepaid one?

No. The prepaid terms state that the entire $438.42 is charged immediately and forfeited for cancellation, no-show, or date changes. The hotel may consider an emergency exception, but the rate does not provide one contractually. The $496.40 rate can be canceled without charge until 6:00 p.m. local hotel time on Sunday, November 8; after that, the penalty is one night plus tax, $248.20.
Then use the cancelable king at Cherry Creek. Before you reserve it, confirm the dates, occupancy, and that Wednesday checkout still works with my 4:00 p.m. release and evening flight.

The reservation will be for one adult in one king room, arriving Monday, November 9 and checking out Wednesday, November 11, for two nights. Checkout is 12:00 p.m. Wednesday. The hotel will store your carry-on suitcase after checkout at no charge while you are at the facility. You can take the documentation case with you Wednesday morning, then leave for DEN after the 4:00 p.m. release. The hotel total is $496.40, with cancellation allowed through 6:00 p.m. Sunday, November 8.
Reserve that rate. Add a note that I expect to leave the suitcase after checkout Wednesday, and give me the final record with Tuesday’s timing.

Reserved Hyatt Place Denver/Cherry Creek under confirmation HPC-739284. The stay is Monday, November 9 through Wednesday, November 11, for one adult in a king room. The complete two-night charge is $496.40 including taxes; breakfast and standard Wi-Fi are included, and there are no mandatory resort, destination, or parking charges. Cancellation is free through 6:00 p.m. local time Sunday, November 8; afterward the penalty is $248.20. No charge has been collected beyond any temporary card verification.

The reservation notes Wednesday post-checkout storage for your carry-on suitcase. The hotel also confirmed that both the suitcase and hard-sided documentation case can be tagged at the luggage desk around 7:00 a.m. Tuesday without a storage fee. For Tuesday’s 9:00 a.m. inspection, request the rideshare at 8:15 a.m. to target arrival by 8:45 a.m.
